hints.title: CREATURES OF THE DEEP
hints.text: You can outrun every creature in the mine. They get you where you cannot get away: in a narrow tunnel, in a dead end, or while you stand still. Each has one sharp sense - and one weakness.
hints.task: Four creatures bar the way to the four elements. The first is a bat: go east.

hints.title: THE BAT
hints.text: A bat sleeps until it sees you - and it sees ten tiles down a straight tunnel. Then it flies at you, and in this dead-end tunnel there is nowhere to go. It cannot pass a boulder, and a boulder shoved into it crushes it.
hints.task: The copper sits in the roof at the far end, and the way on leads through it. Push the boulder ahead of you, all the way down the tunnel.

hints.title: THE SNAKE
hints.text: A snake notices you only within three tiles, and loses you as soon as you are further off. This one lies in the tunnel you need, beyond the opposite corner of this ring.
hints.task: Go close enough to wake it, let it come out after you, then run round the pillar the other way and into its tunnel. Dig straight on: the boulder above drops and shuts it out.

hints.title: THE SPIDER
hints.text: A spider is blind: you can walk right past it. But it feels the ground shake - every tile you dig and every blast within 15 tiles, a pick-up within 5 - and it walks to the spot.
hints.task: It sits in the way out, at the bottom of this ring. Dig the earth in the top left corner to call it, get out of that corner at once, and slip round the other side while it is on its way.

hints.title: THE CRAB
hints.text: A crab is slow, but earth does not stop it: it eats its way through. A falling boulder bounces off its shell. A blast kills it - any creature within two tiles of the stick. Mind the fuse: every step you take burns it like a second.
hints.task: Take the dynamite and dig towards the crab until one tile of earth is left between you. Lay a stick (key 1), step back two tiles and stand still.
